description: Sites detected using one specific technology, newest first. Use find_sites instead when combining a technology with a country, category or contact filter. For counts, shares or 'which X do these sites use', call stack_breakdown instead; it answers in one call. Counts one site from the monthly allowance for each site not already returned to you this period.

confirm.description: Set true to skip the cost confirmation and return the data immediately.

includeQuality.description: Include quality bands for each site.

limit.description: How many sites to return, 1-100. Default 50.

near.description: Only sites near a place: a town or city, a postcode, or 'lat,lng', e.g. Bristol. Use with radius. Sites we could not place are left out.

offset.description: How many to skip, for paging.

radius.description: How far from near, e.g. 30mi or 50km (a bare number is km). From 5 to 248 miles (8 to 400 km).

regions.description: Only sites in these states, provinces or other regions, e.g. ["Texas", "Oklahoma"]. Each a name, a name and country such as 'Georgia, US', or an id such as US-TX. A site matches if it is in ANY of them. Sites we could not place are left out.

technology.description: Technology name, exactly as returned by list_technologies.

until.description: Latest launch date, YYYY-MM-DD. Inclusive of the whole day.

name: technology_sites
title: Sites using a technology
